title: HIV-1 protease teaching subset
purpose: A four-record local input example for BioQUBO Studio's molecular-library prioritization workflow. It is not an activity, potency, docking, affinity, efficacy, safety, or clinical dataset.

target_context.description: HIV-1 protease structure; accession is included as teaching context only and is not used by the molecular-prioritization algorithm. No PDB coordinate file is bundled.

source.method: Individual molecule records retrieved from the public ChEMBL web API by name; canonical SMILES and ChEMBL identifiers retained.
